title: Domain property transported from a filtered colimit cocone
statement: For a filtered diagram of commutative rings, if every stage is a domain and a cocone is colimiting, then its vertex is a domain after identifying it with a specified ring.

source.place: Stacks Project, Algebra, Tag 037D, common-stage lifting argument

proof.text: Represent two elements at stages, lift both to a common stage, use the domain property there, and detect any zero relation at a later stage by filteredness; transport the resulting IsDomain instance along the vertex equality.

mathlib_searches.query: filtered colimit of domains is a domain

lean.statement: theorem isDomain_of_filtered_colimit_cocone {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I] (D : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone D) (hc : IsColimit c) (hD : ∀ i : I, IsDomain (D.obj i)) {R : CommRingCat.{u}} (e : c.pt = R) : IsDomain R
